Model_1_GBT_Regressor.how: Trains decision trees sequentially on prior trees' residual errors (80/20 split, seed=42).
Model_1_GBT_Regressor.why: Models non-linear time, speed, and duration effects for grid load forecasting.

Model_2_RF_Regressor.what: Parallel bagging tree-ensemble benchmark for session energy (kWh).
Model_2_RF_Regressor.how: Averages predictions from 100 independent decision trees (50 in Spark) on random samples.
Model_2_RF_Regressor.why: Benchmarks GBT; achieved slightly lower error and better R2.

Model_3_RF_Classifier.how: Majority vote across 100 decision trees (50 in Spark) on time and bay features.
Model_3_RF_Classifier.why: Helps EV commuters avoid peak-hour queues (note: synthetic target is derived from Hour).

Model_4_Linear_Regression.what: OLS linear model estimating active charging duration in minutes.
Model_4_Linear_Regression.how: Fits linear weights minimizing squared error on energy, charger type, and time.
Model_4_Linear_Regression.why: Gives drivers fast trip-stop time estimates (strong R2 due to Energy_kWh & IsDCFC).

Model_5_KMeans_Clustering.what: Spatial clustering (k=4) identifying 4 optimal charging hub centroids.
Model_5_KMeans_Clustering.how: Groups deduplicated (Latitude, Longitude) pairs to minimize within-cluster squared distance (WSSSE).
Model_5_KMeans_Clustering.why: Guides municipal planners on where to place new high-capacity EV hubs.
